That is still within M3-04's at most two buffers sized to what is shown. The fb19cb9 side of the comparison is M3's own memory-before--window.json, whose code (revision 2's) hasn't changed.

CI run 43743804662 on 45a17b3, job sway (one of main's 19 required checks): a headless sway of the tests' own on ubuntu-24.04, with CHATMON_SWAY=1 making a missing piece a failure, ran tests/test_sway.py and tests/test_wayland.py: 49 passed, 3 skipped.
